name: Switchgear panel
summary: A generic arrangement object linking switching equipment to its manufacturer drawings.
description: A switchgear-panel object represents the equipment envelope and interfaces used when arranging a switchroom or substation. The manufacturer and panel configuration establish the physical dimensions, cable entries, access sides and other installation information.

The original envelope illustration is unscaled and has no manufacturer dimensions. Follow the cited public resources to the exact product, then use its current drawing and installation information for engineering work.
readingNotes: Read plan and elevation views together.
Identify the actual panel configuration before placing its footprint.
drawingChecklist: Identify cable interfaces and access sides.
distinction: The panel envelope is a physical object; the breaker or switch symbol inside an SLD is an electrical representation.

publicSources.title: Secondary-distribution switchgear and ring main units
publicSources.scope: Public equipment families for secondary distribution. Footprints and ratings must come from the chosen model.

publicSources.title: Official CAD drawings and BIM resources
publicSources.scope: Manufacturer CAD/BIM directory for model-specific equipment. Download terms remain with the publisher.
